title: Voice, Speech & Sound Production Factory
objective: Provide deterministic local-first voice, speech and sound production preparation over completed PCA audio-authoring foundations while preserving AAI audio semantics/playback authority, DWC constructed-language pronunciation authority, ARI resource/provenance/rights authority and canonical speaker/narrative/runtime owner domains, and keeping generated media distinct from canonical speech intent, pronunciation truth, live playback or publication.

scope.purpose: Prepare local-first, provider-replaceable voice, speech and sound production candidates over existing audio-authoring and owner references without replacing AAI, DWC-SPEECH, ARI or canonical speaker/narrative/runtime authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative authorized PCA-07 authoring, AAI, DWC-SPEECH, speaker-owner and ARI inputs can deterministically prepare inspectable voice/speech/sound candidate-production plans with stable provenance and fail-closed invalid owner/reference/rights/adapter states while preserving AAI/DWC/ARI/canonical owner authority and remaining useful with optional external synthesis/audio providers disabled.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after PCA-07 exact-tree publication. PCA-07 satisfies PCA-08's direct milestone but unlocks no rotation or studio start; MSAS still requires PCA-08, PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER, so PCA-08 is the lawful next PCA item.
PCA-08 governed-started by owner Continue from exact application main 4d09fba1600efb183370a73a66eadb54b89d922f on branch work/pca-08-voice-speech-sound-production-factory.
PCA-01..07 remain completed foundations and must not be silently reimplemented or weakened.
AAI retains audio semantic/playback authority and DWC-SPEECH retains constructed-language pronunciation authority; PCA-08 is production tooling only.

ARI retains resource identity, source/derivative lineage, bytes/reference state and rights/use authority; generated voice/speech/sound media remains candidate output until owner-governed registration/acceptance/publication.
Canonical speaker, dialogue/narrative and runtime owner domains retain semantic truth; generated media must not silently become speech intent, dialogue truth, Character state or live playback.
Detailed PCA-08 voice/speech/sound, speaker-owner, DWC/AAI/ARI and optional-provider seams are loaded only as required by the governed implementation proof.
PCA-09+, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work are not authorized by this tranche.
next_action: Establish focused PCA-08 RED acceptance and validation profile, observe the expected missing-contract failure, then implement the bounded factory contract and complete proof/closeout.
